verses.sanskrit:
सञ्जय उवाच।
              तद्धर्मशीलस्य वचो निशम्य राज्ञः क्रुद्धस्यातिरथो महात्मा । उवाच दुर्धर्षमदीनसत्त्वं युधिष्ठिरं जिष्णुरनन्तवीर्यः ॥१॥
verses.english: Sanjaya said Hearing those words of the pious kirg, who was all anger, the great warrior Jishnu of indomitable energy said to the irrepressible and

verses.sanskrit:
अर्जुन उवाच।
              संशप्तकैर्युध्यमानस्य मेऽद्य सेनाग्रयायो कुरुसैन्येषु राजन् । आशीविषाभान् खगमान् प्रमुञ्चन् द्रौणिः पुरस्तात्सहसाऽभ्यतिष्ठत् ॥२॥
verses.english: O king, while fighting with the Samsaptakas today, Drona's son, the leader of the Kuru army, all of a sudden came upon me discharging arrows that were like deadly serpents.

verses.sanskrit: दृष्ट्वा रथं मेघरवं ममैव समस्तसेनावरणेऽभ्यतिष्ठन् । तेषामहं पञ्च शतानि हत्वा ततो द्रौणिमगमं पार्थिवाग्र्य ॥३॥
verses.english: Seeing my car rattling like a cloud, all the soldiers stood encircling it. Killing them all, who were full five hundred in number, I proceeded, O mightest of kings, against Drona's son.

verses.sanskrit: स मां समासाद्य नरेन्द्र यत्तः समभ्ययात्सिंहमिव द्विपेन्द्रः । अकार्षीच्च रथिनामुज्जिहीर्षां महाराज वध्यतां कौरवाणाम् ॥४॥
verses.english: Encountering me, O king, the hero rushed resolutely against me like a leader of elephants rushing upon a lion and intended to rescue the warriors who were being slain by me.

verses.sanskrit: ततो रणे भारत दुष्प्रकम्प्य आचार्यपुत्रः प्रवरः कुरूणाम् । मामर्दयामास शितैः पृषत्कैर्जनार्दनं चैव विषाग्निकल्पैः ॥५॥
verses.english: Later on in the battle, the invincible preceptor's son, the foremost of Kuru warriors, afflicted me and Janardana with arrows poignant like poison and fire.

verses.sanskrit: अष्टागवामष्टशतानि बाणान् मया प्रयुद्धस्य वहन्ति तस्य । तांस्तेन मुक्तानहमस्य बाणैर्व्यनाशयं वायुरिवाभ्रजालम् ॥६॥
verses.english: While he fought with me, eight carts each drawn by eight bullocks conveyed his hundreds of arrows. Like a wind dissipating clouds I baffled the arrows he showered upon me.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽपरान्बाणसङ्घाननेकानाकर्णपूर्णायतविप्रमुक्तान् । ससर्ज शिक्षास्त्रबलप्रयत्नैस्तथा यथा प्रावृषि कालमेघः ॥७॥
verses.english: Like a dark cloud discharging its watery contents in downpours he, drawing his bowstring to his very ears, showered upon me with skill and force thousands of other arrows.
verses.bhavadeepa: अष्टौ गावो यस्मिन् तदष्टागवं शकटं तेषामष्टागवामष्ट अष्टसंख्यानि शकटानि । नुडभावः आर्षः । शतानि बाणान् अनेकशतसंख्यान्वहन्ति ॥६॥

verses.sanskrit: नैवाददानं न च संदधानं जानीमहे कतरेणास्यतीति । वामेन वा यदि वा दक्षिणेन स द्रोणपुत्रः समरे पर्यवर्तत् ॥८॥
verses.english: So quickly did he move about in the battlefield that we could not discern from which side did he shoot his arrows, right or left, nor could we ascertain when he took up the arrows and when he discharged them.

verses.sanskrit: तस्याततं मण्डलमेव सज्यं प्रदृश्यते कार्मुकं द्रोणसूनोः । सोऽविध्यन्मां पञ्चभिर्द्रोणपुत्रः शितैः शरैः पञ्चभिर्वासुदेवम् ॥९॥
verses.english: In fact, always we saw the bow of Drona's son drawn to a circle. At last he struck me with five sharp arrows and Vasudeva with another five.

verses.sanskrit: अहं हि तं त्रिंशता वज्रकल्पैः समार्दयं निमिषस्यान्तरेण । क्षणात् श्वावित्समरूपो बभूव समार्दितो मद्विसृष्टैः पृषत्कैः ॥१०॥
verses.english: In a moment, however, I struck him with thirty thunder-bolt like arrows. Greatly wounded with the shafts discharged by me he ere long looked like a porcupine.

verses.sanskrit: स विक्षरन्रुधिरं सर्वगात्रे रथानीकं सूतसूनोर्विवेश । मयाऽभिभूतान्सैनिकानां प्रबर्हानसौ प्रपश्यन्रुधिरप्रदिग्धान् ॥११॥
verses.english: All his limbs were covered with blood. Beholding is soldiers, the best of warriors, bathed in blood and overpowered by me, the son of Suta soon entered into the detachment of car-warriors.

verses.sanskrit: ततोऽभिभूतं युधि वीक्ष्य सैन्यं वित्रस्तयोधं द्रुतवाजिनागम् । पञ्चाशता रथमुख्यैः समेत्य कर्णस्त्वरन्मामुपायात्प्रमाथी ॥१२॥
verses.english: Beholding the soldiers terror-stricken and over-powered by me in battle and seeing the elephants and horses flying away, Karna at once marched against me with fifty car warriors. Killing them, however and avoiding Karna I have come here presently to see you.

verses.sanskrit: तान्सूदयित्वाऽहमपास्य कर्णं द्रष्टुं भवन्तं त्वरयाऽभियातः । सर्वे पञ्चाला ह्युद्विजन्ते स्म कर्णं दृष्ट्वा गावः केसरिणं यथैव ॥१३॥
verses.english: Seeing Karna, the Panchalas are all filled with fright even like the kine on seeing a lion. Like men entering into the gaping jaws of Death the Prabhadrakas, O king, have confronted Karna.

verses.sanskrit: मृत्योरास्यं व्यात्तमिवाभिपद्य प्रभद्रकाः कर्णमासाद्य राजन् । रथांस्तु तान्सप्तशतान्निमग्नांस्तदा कर्णः प्राहिणोन्मृत्युसद्म ॥१४॥
verses.english: Karna has already killed seventeen hundred of these car-warriors. The son of Suta did not lose heart till he came to our view.

verses.sanskrit: न चाप्यभूत्क्लान्तमनाः स राजन् यावन्नास्मान्दृष्टवान् सूतपुत्रः । श्रुत्वा तु त्वां तेन दृष्टं समेतमश्वत्थाम्ना पूर्वतरं क्षतं च ॥१५॥
verses.english: You were first engaged with Ashvatthama and awfully wounded by him. Afterwards Karna saw you. I thought, O you of wonderful deeds, that coming away from the wanton Karna you were enjoying rest.

verses.sanskrit: मन्ये कालमपयानस्य राजन् क्रूरात्कर्णात्तेऽहमचिन्त्यकर्मन् । मया कर्णस्यास्त्रमिदं पुरस्ताद्युद्धे दृष्टं पाण्डव चित्ररूपम् ॥१६॥
न ह्यन्ययोद्धा विद्यते सृञ्जयानां महारथं योऽद्य सहेत कर्णम् । शैनेयो मे सात्यकिश्चक्ररक्षौ धृष्टद्युम्नश्चापि तथैव राजन् ॥१७॥
verses.english: O son of Pandu, I saw Karna's wonderful weapon being carried in front of the army. Methinks there is none amongst the Srinjayas who will be able to withstand the mighty carwarrior Karna.

verses.sanskrit: युधामन्युश्चोत्तमौजाश्च शूरौ पृष्ठतो मां रक्षतां राजपुत्रौ । रथप्रवीरेण महानुभाव द्विषत्सैन्ये वर्तता दुस्तरेण ॥१८॥
verses.english: O king, let Srini's grandson, Satyaki and Dhristadyumna guard my two wings. Let the heroic princes Yudhamanyu and Uttamaujas protect my rear.

verses.sanskrit: समेत्याहं सूतपुत्रेण संख्ये वृत्रेण वज्रीव नरेन्द्रमुख्य । योत्स्याम्यहं भारत सूतपुत्रमस्मिन्संग्रामे यदि वै दृश्यतेऽद्य ॥१९॥
verses.english: O illustrious and most mighty king, as Shakra encountered Vitra, I shall today fight with Suta's son, that heroic and invincible carwarrior, if he can be found in this battle.

verses.sanskrit: आयाहि पश्याद्य युयुत्समानं मां सूतपुत्रस्य रणे जयाय । महर्षभस्येव मुखं प्रपन्नाः प्रभद्रकाः कर्णमभिद्रवन्ति ॥२०॥
verses.english: Come and see us fight with each other in battle for victory. Like persons facing a powerful bull the Prabhadrakas are charging upon Karna.

verses.sanskrit: षट्साहस्रा भारत राजपुत्राः स्वर्गाय लोकाय रणे निमग्नाः । कर्णं न चेदद्य निहन्मि राजन् सबान्धवं युध्यमानं प्रसह्य ॥२१॥
verses.english: Six thousands of kings are giving their lives for heaven. If however, O king, displaying all my strength I do not kill Karna with is allies in battle, I shall be doomed, O lion among kings to the curse which falls to the lot of one who promises a thing and does not redeem it.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतिश्रुत्याकुर्वतो वै गतिर्या कष्टा याता तामहं राजसिंह । आमन्त्रये त्वां ब्रूहि जयं रणे मे पुरा भीमं धार्तराष्ट्रा ग्रसन्ते ॥२२॥
verses.english: I seek your blessing, O king, do say that victory will be mine' There the sons of Dhritarashtra are about to devour Bhima, I will slay Karna and his men and all our enemies.

verses.sanskrit: सौतिं हनिष्यामि नरेन्द्रसिंह। सैन्यं तथा शत्रुगणांश्च सर्वान् ॥२३॥
